assays.Description: Antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis (ADCP) is a functional humoral immune assay that quantifies the capacity of antigen-specific antibodies to facilitate phagocytic uptake of antibody-opsonized targets by effector cells, typically monocytes or neutrophils. The assay generally employs fluorescently labeled antigen-coupled beads or target cells incubated with heat-inactivated serum or plasma samples, followed by co-culture with phagocytic effector cells, with uptake measured by flow cytometry. A phagocytosis score is calculated based on the percentage of phagocyte-positive cells and the fluorescence intensity of internalized signal, providing a quantitative readout of Fc-mediated effector function. This assay is commonly used in vaccine immunogenicity studies and therapeutic antibody evaluations to assess non-neutralizing antibody effector functions that may contribute to protective immunity.
assays.Tags: ADCP, phagocytosis assay, opsonophagocytosis, THP-1 phagocytosis, monocyte phagocytosis, bead uptake, antibody-mediated phagocytosis, bead uptake assay, systems serology, ADCP assay, Fc-mediated phagocytosis, opsonophagocytic assay, antibody-dependent phagocytosis

assays.Description: Antibody-dependent complement deposition (ADCD) is a functional humoral immune assay that quantifies the ability of antigen-specific antibodies to activate the complement cascade and deposit complement components (typically C3) onto antigen-coated beads or target surfaces. In this assay, immune complexes formed between sample antibodies and antigen are incubated with a complement source, and subsequent complement deposition is measured by flow cytometry using fluorescently labeled anti-C3 detection reagents. Sample preparation involves heat inactivation of endogenous complement in test sera, followed by incubation with antigen-coupled beads and guinea pig or human complement. Data are acquired on a flow cytometer and reported as median fluorescence intensity (MFI), reflecting the magnitude of complement fixation activity in the sample.
assays.Tags: ADCD assay, complement deposition assay, C3 deposition, complement fixation, opsonization complement assay, ADCD, complement activation, opsonization complement, antibody complement fixing, complement deposition, C3 deposition assay, opsonization, systems serology, C3b deposition, classical complement pathway
assays.Alternative_Assay_Names: ADCD Analysis, Antibody Dependent Complement Deposition, Antibody-dependent Complement Deposition

assays.Description: Antibody Dependent Functional Profiling (ADFP) is a multiplexed assay that characterizes the functional capacity of antigen-specific antibodies by simultaneously measuring multiple Fc-mediated effector functions, including antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC), antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis (ADCP), antibody-dependent neutrophil phagocytosis (ADNP), and complement deposition (ADCD). The assay employs Luminex-based bead arrays coupled with flow cytometry to profile antibody-mediated recruitment and activation of innate immune effector cells, utilizing fluorescently labeled antigen-coupled microspheres incubated with serum samples and relevant effector cells or complement sources. Data outputs include median fluorescence intensity (MFI) and phagocytic or cytotoxic scores derived from multiparameter flow cytometric analysis, enabling high-throughput, systems-level characterization of humoral immune responses across large sample cohorts.
assays.Tags: ADFP, antibody-dependent functional profiling, systems serology, Fc effector function, immune functional fingerprint, antibody effector function, functional immune profiling, Fc effector profiling, humoral immune function, ADFP assay, Fc effector function panel, multiplexed antibody effector assay
assays.Alternative_Assay_Names: Antibody Dependent Functional Profiling, Antibody Functional Profiling
assays.Children_Sample_Types: D.ADCD or D.ADCP or D.ADNKA or D.ADNP or D.ADMP or D.ADDCP

assays.Description: Antibody-Dependent Neutrophil Phagocytosis (ADNP) is a functional immunoassay that measures the capacity of antigen-specific antibodies to opsonize targets and drive their uptake by primary human neutrophils via Fc receptor engagement. Antigen-coated fluorescent beads or immune complexes are incubated with serum or plasma, then combined with freshly isolated neutrophils. After incubation, phagocytic activity is quantified by flow cytometry, measuring the percentage of neutrophils that have internalized fluorescent beads and/or the fluorescence intensity per cell. Results are reported as a phagocytic score (percent positive cells × mean fluorescence intensity) providing a functional measure of antibody-dependent neutrophil phagocytosis (ADNP) activity mediated by innate immune effector cells. ADNP is a key component of systems serology profiling, reflecting the ability of antibodies to recruit neutrophil-mediated clearance mechanisms.
assays.Tags: ADNP, neutrophil phagocytosis assay, granulocyte phagocytosis, antibody-mediated neutrophil uptake, neutrophil phagocytosis, innate immune effector, systems serology, ADNP assay, Fc-mediated neutrophil phagocytosis, primary neutrophil phagocytosis, HL-60 phagocytosis, neutrophil bead uptake

attributes.title: UID
attributes.meaning: The unique NExtSEEK identifier for this sample. Its prefix is the sample type code. BMC data specialist will create them for new samples.

attributes.title: Name
attributes.meaning: The identifier the submitting lab uses for this sample.

attributes.title: Scientist
attributes.meaning: The lab member responsible for this sample.

attributes.title: SampleCreationDate
attributes.meaning: The date this sample itself was created, as distinct from when the record was entered.

attributes.title: Protocol
attributes.meaning: The SOP followed, as a filename or a link to the SOP record. BMC data specialists can handle this section if given all protocols used.

attributes.title: Species
attributes.meaning: The species, as the scientific binomial where possible, e.g. Macaca mulatta.

attributes.title: StorageSite
attributes.meaning: The freezer or cryotank this sample is stored in.

attributes.title: StorageLocation
attributes.meaning: Where this sample is physically stored.

attributes.title: StorageType
attributes.meaning: The medium or buffer this sample is stored in, e.g. DMEM with 5% DMSO.

attributes.title: Parent
attributes.meaning: UID(s) of the sample(s) this one was derived from. Semicolon-separate when several.

attributes.title: Substrain
attributes.meaning: The specific substrain used, including any plasmid it carries.

attributes.title: Genotype
attributes.meaning: The genotype of the animal or cell line.

attributes.title: Phenotype
attributes.meaning: The observed phenotype of this subject or cell line, e.g. Epithelial, LTBI.

attributes.title: Morphology
attributes.meaning: The morphology of the organism or cell type, e.g. Bacillus, epithelial.

attributes.title: Source
attributes.meaning: Where this material was obtained from, e.g. ATCC, Lonza.

attributes.title: Culture
attributes.meaning: The culture medium and conditions used to grow this organism.

attributes.title: ODFrozen
attributes.meaning: The optical density the culture was at when frozen.

attributes.title: Notes
attributes.meaning: Any additional information.

attributes.title: Publish_uri
attributes.meaning: Public URL where this sample record is published.

attributes.title: Strain
attributes.meaning: The strain designation of the animal or organism, e.g. C57BL/6J, H37Rv.

attributes.title: TaxonomyID
attributes.meaning: The NCBI Taxonomy identifier for the organism, e.g. 83332 for M. tuberculosis H37Rv.

attributes.title: GramStaining
attributes.meaning: The Gram stain result for this organism, e.g. Positive, Acid Fast.

attributes.title: Barcode
attributes.meaning: The nucleotide barcode identifying this sample within a pooled run, e.g. GAATTGCT.

attributes.title: Qtag
attributes.meaning: The quantification tag sequence used for this strain.

attributes.title: Lab
attributes.meaning: The lab that owns or generated this sample.

attributes.title: Link_Sequence
attributes.meaning: Download URL or storage path for the sequence file.
